caveats: Market questions (e.g. 'US strikes Iran by <date>') are not the ICB onset event the model was trained on; the raw model Brier is reported for transparency, not as a like-for-like score.
Ceasefire / 'war ends' markets are flipped so YES always means escalation.
Markets are all from 2023-11 onward, i.e. after the ICB label window (through 2021-12-31): the model's trees and calibration are fully out-of-sample here.
Selection: escalation keyword filter, volume >= $250,000, a price 30 days before resolution, at most 1 markets per event and 5 per country pair.
Leave-one-out stacks refit a 1-2 parameter logistic on the other markets; with n this small the market-only vs market+model gap is indicative, not significant.
